pulls.author: shivshah-oracle
pulls.body_excerpt: The test builds a chain of weak references, clears the array entries from the beginning, and expects the final reference to be cleared by a full GC. GC may clear it and place it on the pending reference list, which keeps the reference object alive until the reference handler processes it. pulls.author: raneashay
pulls.body_excerpt: Prior to this patch, the `StackYellowPages` and `StackRedPages` influenced the total reserved stack memory, but they didn't change the minimum stack size specified as required by HotSpot to Windows. pulls.author: navyxliu
pulls.activity: 已关闭、2 个 Review、3 条评论
pulls.body_excerpt: This patch cleans up static template functions in headers. If a template function is static, C++ compilers use internal linkage. 1. the good case: nobody in TranslationUnit(TU) uses it. We get a warning. 2. the bad case: multiple TUs do use it.
